headline: Nevish Line Post Falls to Ruins; Weathered Expanse Fighting Heaviest
war_summary: The morning brings one change to the boards. Nevish Line, seven Warden posts and one Colonial at the last filing, now reads six Warden, one Colonial and one ruined post, the sector still logging events as this dispatch was filed. Along the rest of the line the colors hold as the evening edition left them: Linn Mercy wholly Colonial at eleven; Callahan's Passage nine Warden to one Colonial; Stonecradle seven Colonial to two Warden; Stlican Shelf six Colonial to three Warden; the Weathered Expanse seven Colonial to two Warden; Mooring County all twelve Warden; Viper Pit eight Warden; Fisherman's Row nine Colonial to none. Fifteen events were recorded across seven sectors in the past two hours — four in the Weathered Expanse and two each in Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, Stlican Shelf, Nevish Line and Linn Mercy, with one at Palantine Berm. Casualty ledgers for the day are heaviest in the Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle, Nevish Line, Callahan's Passage and Mooring County. The war stands at day 449, no victor declared.
